$description: CSS-native token values: values with no DTCG type, declared by hand in *.native.css files. Each entry says why it cannot be a DTCG token. build-css-from-dtcg.mjs --check fails on an unlisted declaration or a stale entry. See docs/design-system/token-single-source.md.
